name: Cinnamon Rolls
author: The Infinity Pizza on based.cooking
steps: In a large bowl, mix all dough ingredients except butter.

Knead in the butter gradually until dough passes the "Windowpane Test": Take a piece of the dough and stretch it gently apart, it should spread out smoothly until light is visible through the dough without tearing. This is a sign of good gluten development.
In a small bowl, mix all filling ingredients.
Take risen dough and roll it into a rectangle the size of your pan.
Spread your filling inside your dough.
Roll the dough into a log and cut into rolls.
Place inside your pan and let rise for 30 minutes.
Wash melted butter over your rolls and bake at 175°C.
Drizzle frosting as soon as rolls come out of the oven, let cool, tear and serve.

culture.text: A cinnamon roll is a sweet roll commonly served in Northern Europe and North America. Alternative recipes use puff pastry instead of yeasted dough, but are constructed using a similar method.
